atelier — one owner per task, observed evidence, the project owner decides.

[--sandbox-only] [--refuse-overlap] [--approval TEXT] [--regenerate CMD] [--review-bar TEXT] [--review-tier H/M,H/M] [--reset] [--history-since YYYY-MM-DD] · sync · publish
           notes-remote [REMOTE | --off]

           ls [--all] [--json] · show ID [--reviews] [--json] · owners [--json] · inbox [--json] · status [--project P] [--json] (with a project: where it stands, as text) · open

           claim ID --as H/M [--runner home:NAME] · finish [--sandbox] [--summary T] · push [--force | --rollback] · update · check [--sandbox] [--merged] [-- CMD] · report [ID] "what you verified and how" [--item ID] [--project P] · submit [--summary T]
           handoff ID --to H/M [--note TEXT] · release ID [--note TEXT] · block [ID] "what it is waiting on" · unblock [ID] · diff ID · review ID --approve|--reject [--note TEXT] [--head SHA] [--findings JSON] · review-claim ID [--runner home:NAME] · review-release ID [--note T]
           read-token ID · base-token ID · integrated ID --part KEY --merge-commit SHA · integration-failed ID --part KEY --reason TEXT [--kind conflict|checks] · refreshed ID --main-head SHA [--merge-commit SHA] · refresh-failed ID --main-head SHA --reason TEXT [--kind conflict|checks]

Projects   projects rename OLD NEW · projects remove NAME [--force] · showcase set NAME [--named|--anonymous] · showcase remove NAME · init --name NAME --rename-local
           
           adopt --project NAME [--as H/M]   (a ControlPlane project moves to Atelier)
Local      gc [--project NAME] [--dry-run | --apply] · runner --name home:NAME [--once] [--config PATH] [--integrate]
           runner --discover [--name home:NAME] [--probe] [--dry-run] [--config PATH]   (what each home model's harness serves)
           runner --usage [--name home:NAME] [--dry-run] [--config PATH]   (each tool's windows, served models, costs and balances)
Ops        ops COMMAND [ARGS...]   (portfolio operations, run by the private atelier-ops toolkit when installed)
Docs       guide   (paste into a project's AGENTS.md)

Tokens     token issue --as H/M [--project P]... [--days N] [--label TEXT] · token ls · token revoke ID
Common flags: --project NAME, --as harness/model (or ATELIER_ACTOR). A switch such as --approve, --json or --sandbox-only is on when named alone. It takes the word true or false after it and never any other word: --sandbox-only false or --sandbox-only=false turns it off.
Undo: revert ID
